cap_pistol.name: Cap Pistol
cap_pistol.desc: Ballistics, tier 2 schematic. A short percussion pistol. Loud, simple, and jams where magic runs thick.

steam_maul.name: Steam Maul
steam_maul.desc: Steamworks, tier 2 schematic. A pocket boiler drives a piston into the head.

spark_baton.name: Spark Baton
spark_baton.desc: Galvanics, tier 1 schematic. A cell in the grip, a coil in the head. The shock works better where Resonance is low.

galvanic_rifle.name: Galvanic Rifle
galvanic_rifle.desc: Cross-trade patent (Ballistics 5 + Galvanics 5). Coils fling the ball; a spark follows it in.

brass_spyglass.name: Brass Spyglass
brass_spyglass.desc: Optics, tier 1 schematic. Two ground lenses in a brass tube. Spot sites from further away (used by exploration later).

rifle_scope.name: Rifle Scope
rifle_scope.desc: Optics, tier 1 schematic. Fits a rifle for later weapon modding.

powder_charge.name: Powder Charge
powder_charge.desc: Demolition, tier 1 schematic. Clears rubble, opens sealed doors, ends arguments. Used by quests and ruins.

smoke_pot.name: Smoke Pot
smoke_pot.desc: Demolition, tier 1 schematic. A clay pot of smouldering resin and powder. For escapes (stealth hooks later).

iron_dagger.name: Iron Dagger
iron_dagger.desc: Smithing recipe. Plain and honest. Takes an enchantment well.

iron_hatchet.name: Iron Hatchet
iron_hatchet.desc: Smithing recipe. A woodsman's axe that doubles as a weapon.

smiths_buckler.name: Iron Buckler
smiths_buckler.desc: Smithing recipe. A small iron shield. +1 AC. Equip slots arrive with the character system; for now it's enchantable stock.

lantern_water.name: Lantern Water
lantern_water.desc: Consecration formula. Shrine water blessed in the Lantern Mother's name. Lifts the curse from one cursed item in the user's pack.

ward_salve.name: Ward Salve
ward_salve.desc: Herbalism formula. A pale balm that closes small cuts. Restores 1d4+1 HP.

schematic_clockwork_trigger.name: Schematic: Clockwork Trigger
schematic_clockwork_trigger.desc: Oil-stained drafting paper with a Combine stamp. Found schematics teach their design even if you haven't reached the tier to build it.

schematic_rifle_scope.name: Schematic: Rifle Scope
schematic_rifle_scope.desc: A guild-copied optics diagram, registration number filed off.

formula_storm_brand.name: Formula: Storm Brand
formula_storm_brand.desc: A Collegium enchanter's notes in a tidy hand, with one glyph circled three times.

recipe_iron_buckler.name: Recipe: Iron Buckler
recipe_iron_buckler.desc: A smith's chalk sketch on a slate.
